score.summary: The corporate customer segment generates the most revenue at $210,905.52 from 271 orders.

result.summary: The corporate customer segment generates the most revenue at $210,905.52 from 271 orders.

findings.statement: Corporate segment has the highest total revenue among all customer segments.
findings.method: SQL aggregation with JOIN between orders and customers tables, grouped by segment and summed order_value
findings.code:
SELECT c.segment, SUM(o.order_value) as total_revenue, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
